prompt: She is ___ engineer.
explanation: Meslek bildirirken a/an kullanılır; engineer sesli harfle başladığı için an.

prompt: I'd like ___ glass of water.
explanation: Sayılabilir tekil isim ilk kez anılıyor: a glass of water. glass sessiz harfle başlar → a.

prompt: ___ sun rises in the east.
explanation: Tek olan şeyler (the sun, the moon, the sky, the world) the ile kullanılır.

prompt: He plays ___ guitar very well.
explanation: Çalgı aletleriyle the kullanılır: play the guitar / the piano. Sporlarla ise artikel yoktur: play football.

prompt: My sister lives in ___ United Kingdom.
explanation: Birleşik/çoğul adlı ülkeler the ile kullanılır: the United Kingdom, the USA, the Netherlands.

prompt: ___ life is full of surprises. (genel olarak hayat)
explanation: Genel anlamda sayılamayan ve çoğul isimler artikelsiz kullanılır: life, love, music, people.

prompt: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning. (öğrenci olarak)
explanation: school, church, hospital, bed, prison gibi yerlerin asıl amacıyla kullanıldığı durumda artikel yoktur: go to school (okula gitmek).

prompt: I bought a car and a bike. ___ car is red.
explanation: Daha önce söz edilen ve belirli hale gelen isim the alır: a car → the car.

prompt: What ___ beautiful day!
explanation: What + sayılabilir tekil isim ünlemlerinde a / an gerekir: What a beautiful day! (beautiful sessiz harfle başlar → a)

prompt: He is ___ most intelligent student in the class.
explanation: Üstünlük derecesi (the most, the best) hep the ile kullanılır.

prompt: She has ___ MA in linguistics. (MA: /em ey/)
explanation: Artikel yazıya değil söyleniş sesine bakar: MA “em-ey” diye sesli harfle başlar → an MA.

prompt: ___ Nile is the longest river in Africa.
explanation: Nehir, deniz, okyanus ve dağ silsileleri the ile kullanılır: the Nile, the Alps, the Atlantic.

prompt: She works at an hospital near here.
explanation: hospital /h/ sesiyle başlar (sessiz) olduğu için a kullanılır: a hospital. an yalnızca sesli harf sesinden önce gelir.

prompt: I need an advice about my career.
explanation: advice sayılamayan bir isimdir: a / an almaz. some advice ya da a piece of advice denir.

prompt: She plays the football with her friends every weekend.
explanation: Spor adlarında artikel kullanılmaz: play football, play tennis. (the yalnızca çalgılarla: play the piano.)

prompt: She said, “I am tired.” → She said that she ___ tired.
explanation: Dolaylı anlatımda ana fiil geçmişse, am/is → was olur (bir adım geriye gidilir).

prompt: He said, “I have finished.” → He said he ___ finished.
explanation: present perfect → past perfect: have finished → had finished.

prompt: “I will call you.” → She said she ___ call me.
explanation: will → would: dolaylı anlatımda gelecek zaman “future in the past” olur.

prompt: “Where do you live?” → He asked me where I ___.
explanation: Dolaylı sorularda düz cümle sırası kullanılır (yardımcı fiil did yok) ve zaman bir adım geri gider: where I lived.

prompt: “Do you like coffee?” → She asked ___ I liked coffee.
explanation: Evet/hayır sorularının dolaylı anlatımı if ya da whether ile kurulur.

prompt: “Close the door.” → He told me ___ the door.
explanation: Emirler tell + kişi + to + fiil ile aktarılır: he told me to close the door.

prompt: “Don't be late.” → She told us ___ late.
explanation: Olumsuz emir: tell + kişi + not to + fiil: she told us not to be late.

prompt: “We are leaving tomorrow.” → They said they were leaving ___ day.
explanation: Zaman ifadeleri kayar: tomorrow → the next day / the following day.

prompt: “I saw him yesterday.” → She said she had seen him ___.
explanation: yesterday → the day before (ya da the previous day) olur.

prompt: “I can swim.” → She said she ___ swim.
explanation: can → could: dolaylı anlatımda modal fiiller de bir adım geri gider.

prompt: “I'm working here.” → He said he ___ working there.
explanation: am / is / are + -ing → was / were + -ing; here → there olur: he said he was working there.

prompt: “Why did you leave?” → She asked me why I ___ left.
explanation: Simple past → past perfect: did leave → had left. Dolaylı soruda düz cümle sırası kullanılır.

prompt: She said me that she was tired.
explanation: said’den sonra kişi nesnesi gelmez: she said that… ya da she told me that… Kişi varsa tell kullanılır.

prompt: He asked me where did I live.
explanation: Dolaylı soruda did gibi yardımcı fiil ve devrik sıra kullanılmaz: he asked me where I lived.

prompt: She told that she would come late.
explanation: tell yanında kişi ister (told me / told him). Kişi söylenmeyecekse said that kullanılır.
